description: GTFS Real-Time sources for Belfast / Northern Ireland

sources.name: Northern Ireland Buses (BODS bounding box)
sources.coverage: All registered bus operators in Northern Ireland — Translink Ulsterbus, Metro Belfast, Glider BRT
sources.note: BODS regulations do not mandate NI operators to publish live vehicle positions; feed may contain timetable data only. API key: https://data.bus-data.dft.gov.uk/account/signup/

sources.name: Transport for Ireland Vehicle Positions
sources.coverage: Republic of Ireland buses + cross-border Translink/Bus Éireann services into NI

sources.name: Transport for Ireland Trip Updates
sources.coverage: Republic of Ireland trip delay and cancellation data
sources.note: Same NTA key as vehicle positions

sources.name: Transport for Ireland Rail (DART / Enterprise)
sources.coverage: DART, Dublin commuter rail, Enterprise Belfast–Dublin (via Newry)
sources.note: Same NTA key. Enterprise is the only direct Belfast–Dublin rail service.
